notes: India Post Payments Bank KYC smishing. The first two lines are the link preview. Same message also fact-checked on PDF pages 26, 58 and 165. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
